title: Monthly chargeback: private generation, scoped delivery
subtitle: Merged P50 · a separate reports deployment reads existing gateway telemetry. Network choices are discovered, not assumed. It neither depends on Turnstile nor changes the inference path.

groups.title: Existing source APIs · authenticated, read-only access
Reports network scope · discovered existing VNet or explicitly sized new VNet
groups.subtitle: Private Blob + DNS; [[entrypoint]]

nodes.title: Log Analytics
lines: Server-side aggregation; previous UTC month by default.
Person pages split by hash, not truncated.

nodes.title: Start the manual admin job
lines: Fixed command; no supplied shell text.

nodes.title: 1 · Monthly generator job
lines: Reconcile workspace, units + Unassigned, then people.
Partial results or mismatches: no report.

nodes.title: 2 · Versioned private settings
lines: Recipients, exact allowed domains, selected units, formats and retention.
Workers read; only the admin identity writes.

nodes.title: 3 · Private administration job
lines: Off-network inspection returns counts, never address lists.

nodes.title: 4 · Private reports container
lines: Scoped CSV / HTML + manifest; artifact hashes and query provenance.

nodes.title: 5 · Archive-backed outbox
lines: Pending blobs under outbox/ carry scope and [[hashes]], not addresses.

nodes.title: 6 · Blob-triggered dispatcher
lines: KEDA polling: 420 s; min 0 / max 1 execution.
Re-read current settings; honor removals and domain restrictions.
One send or poll action per pass. No idle container with an empty outbox.

nodes.title: Reporting UAMI · generator, scaler and dispatcher
lines: Log Analytics Reader on the workspace; named-value read only at APIM.
Blob Data Reader on configuration; Blob Data Contributor on reports.
Dedicated ACS resource: custom read/write role, no keys or delete.
This is not an email-send-only permission; ACS exposes no such data action here.

nodes.title: 7 · Entra-authenticated ACS Email
lines: POST [[email-route]]; poll the same operation id.
Communication Services links to Email Service's [[managed-domain]].
Record operation ids, status and recipient counts.

nodes.title: 8 · Scope-specific BCC delivery
lines: [[bcc]] receives only that unit's HTML and CSV parts.
Explicit all-units recipients receive the selected report set.
No SAS / unrestricted download link. Team-specific recipients are deferred.
ACS acceptance is not proof of inbox placement.

nodes.title: Additional resource types declared by the merged P50 profile

notice: Azure-managed domains allow at most 10 sends/hour. One send plus one poll at 420-second pacing is about 4.3 completed messages/hour; additional polls are slower. Hundreds of units need a verified custom domain and approved quota for timely production delivery. Cost remains showback, not an invoice; cache writes remain unknown.
